Name: Small Beach Farm
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Small Beach Farm[/b] adds a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pocket_beach]pocket beach[/url] farm type suitable for slower or challenge runs, and lets you catch both river and ocean fish. You can configure options like islands, a fishing pier, and beach sounds.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/farm.png[/img]

[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[b]See [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/SmallBeachFarm#enable-the-farm-type]how to enable the farm map[/url]![/b]

[size=5]Highlights[/size]
[list]
[*]The beach is fertile, so you can plant crops in the grass and sand too:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/tilled.png[/img][*]You can catch riverlands fish in the river and ocean fish in the ocean (for both fishing and crab pots):
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/fish-areas.png[/img][*]The exit to Marnie's ranch is on the right:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/exits.png[/img][*]The beach includes a functional campfire you can use (pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4971]Limited Campfire Cooking[/url]):
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/campfire.gif[/img][*]Forage and supply crates can occasionally spawn along the shore:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/supply-crates.png[/img][/list]
[size=5]Tips[/size]
[list]
[*]Fish quality depends on how far from shore the bobber is. The bottom-left area of the river mouth is wide enough to catch max-quality river fish: [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/best-river-spot.png[/img]
[*]If you need more space, download the optional [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] to add some islands:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/farm-islands.png[/img][*]If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], you can connect chests to crab pots all along the beach:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/automate-crabpots.png[/img][/list]
[size=5]Configure[/size]
You can edit the settings in-game or by editing the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]; see [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/SmallBeachFarm#configure][i]configure[/i] in the readme[/url] for more info.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/develop/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/generic-config-menu.png[/img]


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[*]Not compatible with other mods which replace the same farm map.
[/list]
It should work with most map recolors. To add support for a new recolor, see [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/SmallBeachFarm#can-i-add-compatibility-with-a-recolor-mod]details in the readme[/url].
